brief:
Georgian police clashed with Turkish football supporters during a match in Tbilisi, resulting in 16 detentions and three injuries to law enforcement officers, the country's Interior Ministry said. The confrontation occurred as fans displayed pro-Palestinian symbols and messaging at the stadium.

Details of what sparked the initial altercation remain unclear. Georgian authorities did not specify the nature of the Palestinians supporters' actions or statements that prompted the police response.
dek: Georgia's Interior Ministry says 16 people were detained and three employees injured during clashes.
title: Georgian police detain 16 after clashing with Turkish football fans over Palestine
